name: Home
description: EXP-011 §58 fixture: the streaming trio. A JSON Stream Parser fed by a `chunk` Variable two Load buttons write (a document split mid-string across the two), parsed on its own button; a Text Accumulator (delimiter |) fed the same way; a Stream Buffer (Max Size 3) fed a constant, with Add and Flush buttons. Every value output is shown in a Text; each node's headline signal writes a `status` Variable.
